name: project-planning
description: Start large, ambiguous projects: shape a high-level system design with the user, then turn it into a risk-first roadmap of end-to-end increments

interface.shortDescription: Design a project, then plan it risk-first
interface.longDescription: Shape a high-level system design with flagged assumptions and a risk register, then order the work as end-to-end increments that each answer the riskiest remaining unknown. Tuned for Apple-platform apps.
defaultPrompt: Use $system-design to shape a high-level design for this project idea.
Use $risk-first-roadmap to turn the system design into an incremental roadmap.
